eligibility_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Participant must be male or nonpregnant female between 18 and 70 years of age (inclusive) at Visit 1 (Screening).
* The participant has a clinical diagnosis of isolated dystonia with symptoms consistent with dystonia for at least one year prior to Visit 1 (Screening); has two or more body regions affected by dystonia at Visit 1 (Screening); and has been confirmed by Investigator and Enrollment Authorization Committee.
* The participant may be untreated with BoNT; OR if the participant is being treated with BoNT as part of their standard of care for dystonia, they must meet protocol-specified criteria.
* The participants must meet protocol-specified requirements for baseline scores on the BFM and CGI-S.
